b6_reason: The correct mapping is (a) Diaphragms - (i) cover the cervix, (b) Pills - (ii) inhibit ovulation and implantation, (c) IUDs - (iii) increase phagocytosis of sperm, (d) Lactational amenorrhea - (iv) absence of cycle after parturition, and no option as rendered carries that mapping.
b6_working: Option 1 = a-iv, b-i, c-iii, d-ii; Option 2 = a-iv, b-i, c-ii, d-iii; Option 3 = a-ii, b-iv, c-i, d-iii; Option 4 = a-iii, b-ii, c-i, d-iv. Correct is a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv, absent from all four; option 4 is nearest, matching on b and d with a and c interchanged.
